definitions.gloss: majority; more than half; the greater part
definitions.explanation: Refers to a quantity exceeding fifty percent. Common in political, statistical, and business contexts.

examples.japanese: {過半|かはん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{議席|ぎせき}→議席：15176_giseki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{獲得|かくとく}→獲得：05624_kakutoku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They won a majority of the seats.

examples.japanese: ⟦{参加者|さんかしゃ}→参加者：03059_sankasha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{過半|かはん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{賛成|さんせい}した→賛成する：05647_sanseisuru⟧。
examples.english: More than half of the participants agreed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{過半|かはん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{占|し}めている→占める：11799_shimeru⟧。
examples.english: The overseas market accounts for the majority of sales.

notes:
A formal, somewhat literary word for "more than half." Most commonly encountered in the compound ⟦{過半数|かはんすう}→過半数：05610_kahansuu⟧ (majority number), which is the standard word for "majority" in voting and parliamentary contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{過半数|かはんすう}→過半数：05610_kahansuu⟧: majority (of votes)
- ⟦{過半数|かはんすう}→過半数：05610_kahansuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{占|し}める→占める：11799_shimeru⟧: to constitute a majority
- {過半|かはん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧: to exceed half

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{大半|たいはん}→大半：00400_taihan⟧: the greater part, most (implies well over half)
- ⟦{半数|はんすう}→半数：30503_hansuu⟧⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧: half or more (more precise, less formal)
- ⟦{多数|たすう}→多数：05612_tasuu⟧: a large number, the majority (not necessarily over 50%)
